releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.36 - Active Escape Recovery & Continuous Multi-Episode Unlocking
releaseNotes:
* Active Escape Recovery & Relaunch: Immediate detection of external app escapes (Play Store, Chrome, Launcher, WhatsApp) with instant back and launch-intent Pocket FM foreground recovery
* Continuous Multi-Episode Unlocking: Full recognition of success dialog hierarchy (ads_view, main_layout) and accurate batch quota parsing (16 ads) for uninterrupted continuous unlocks
* Patient Ad Waiting Protocol: Zero blind touches during video playback (<25s); throttled end-card probing (>=25s) and automatic reward claim at 30s
* Ad Auto-Completion Telemetry: Guarantees ad auto-completion and 30s reward claims update episode and session counters without stalling
* Ad Container Classification Fix: Comprehensive whitelisting for Unity, InMobi, BidMachine, Fyber, AdMob, AppLovin, IronSource, and MBridge SDKs
